reason: Reproduced with published uv 0.12.24 and CPython 3.12.15 on Ubuntu 24.04.5 x86_64. In a temporary directory, create a python3 symlink to the real interpreter, then run `uv --cache-dir warm venv --python ./python3 parent`. Run `uv --cache-dir warm pip list --python parent/bin/python` and repeat with `--cache-dir fresh`; all commands also used --no-config --offline. Decoded cache records show sys_base_executable contains the symlink with the warmed cache but the real python3.12 path with the fresh cache, matching the reported discrepancy. Startup markers confirmed cache reuse versus Python execution. Child venvs also selected different executable targets. The identical setup produced matching metadata and targets with uv 0.12.23 and installed uv 0.12.13. The original Rust test was inspected but not executed on Gentoo. Updated $RUNNER_TEMP/issue-context/README.md with commands, evidence, existing test coverage, and limitations. No checkout or GitHub changes were made.
